title: Composition-Driven Phase Evolution in Sm-Doped BiFeO3 via Latent-Field Reconstruction of Atomically Resolved STEM Data
abstract: arXiv:2608.19544v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Functionalities of ferroelectric materials are governed by the spatial organization and coupling of polarization, strain, lattice rotation, and structural order accessible via atomically resolved scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) images. Quantitative interpretation of atomic-resolution STEM data has conventionally relied on locating atomic columns and converting their fitted coordinates into local structural descriptors. Here, we develop a field-based approach in which atomic-resolution images are represented by spatially varying latent Bragg fields, whose amplitudes and phases provide continuous maps of crystalline order, lattice displacement, strain, rotation, and mode-specific residual structure. The observed atomically resolved images are decoded from the latent fields. translated_title: 基于潜场重建原子分辨STEM数据的Sm掺杂BiFeO3中成分驱动的相演化研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19544v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：铁电材料的功能性由极化、应变、晶格旋转和结构有序性的空间组织与耦合所决定，这些可通过原子分辨扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）图像获取。原子分辨率STEM数据的定量解释传统上依赖于定位原子列并将其拟合坐标转换为局部结构描述符。在此，我们开发了一种基于场的方法，其中原子分辨图像由空间变化的潜布拉格场表示，其振幅和相位提供晶序、晶格位移、应变、旋转和模式特定残余结构的连续图谱。观察到的原子分辨图像从潜场中解码。我们将此框架应用于Sm取代的BiFeO3图像序列，涵盖0-20%的Sm掺杂，并跨越由成分驱动的R3c铁电相边界。
tldr: 提出一种基于潜场重建的原子分辨STEM图像分析方法，实现连续映射晶体结构参数，并成功应用于揭示Sm掺杂BiFeO3中成分驱动的相演化机制。
en_tdlr: A latent-field reconstruction approach for atomically resolved STEM images enables continuous mapping of structural parameters, revealing composition-driven phase evolution in Sm-doped BiFeO3.
